verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Unity only as an MCP server: the in-editor com.unity.ai.assistant bridge and the CLI's `unity mcp` mode let external agents such as Claude Code and Cursor drive the Unity Editor. Nothing shows Unity or its AI Assistant connecting to external MCP servers as a client to use their tools. Server-side evidence belongs to a different story and earns no credit here, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
